0.name: H
0.text: Say, young lady, are you alright?

1.name: H
1.text: You don’t look very well to me.

2.name: H
2.text: Of course, it’s not my place to say anything, but I think you shouldn’t force yourself too much.

3.name: H
3.text: Rest well, eat something healthy and take a deep breath.

4.name: H
4.text: Or… If nothing seems to fix it, no one’s gonna judge you if you indulge a little.

5.name: H
5.text: You know, a bit of candy, puppy videos, catchy music…

8.name: H
8.text: But I won’t bother you too much, it’s your life to live as you wish.

13.name: H
13.text: No need to thank me, of course!
